TRAI Camp Office, Guwahati (under Regional Office Kolkata)

Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Science (Maths and Physics) from a recognized university/institution; retired officers of Central/State Govt/Departments/PSU/Autonomous Bodies at pay level 10 & above at retirement with minimum 15 years of total experience in the relevant field.
Maximum 64 years (as on the date of Vacancy Circular)

content_sections.heading: TRAI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. C-07/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download TRAI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Science (Maths and Physics) from recognized university/Institution; retired at pay level 10 & above with minimum 15 years of total experience in the relevant field Experience: Retired Officers of Central/State Govt/Departments/PSU/Autonomous Bodies carrying the pay level 10 & above at the time of retirement (as per 7th CPC/equivalent level of IDA scale) and minimum 15 years of total experience in the relevant field as on date of issue of vacancy circular Age limit: Maximum 64 years (as on the date of Vacancy Circular) Other conditions: Open to eligible Indian Citizens Must have retired at pay level 10 & above (7th CPC/equivalent IDA level) Should be in good health and capable of performing official duties at the time of engagement Vigilance Clearance shall be obtained for retired officials as per extant CVC/Government guidelines Desirable: Post Graduation in Engineering/Technology/Science (Maths and Physics) from recognized university/Institution Experience of working in Telecom/Broadcasting sector or in central Regulatory Bodies

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for TRAI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received by post, email or other means Incomplete applications or applications without the documents in Para 6(a) to 6(d)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pensionable/DoT PSU retirees: remuneration fixed by Government OMs in Table-I (pension deduction, 50% of notional pay, or 30% deduction for NPS); non-pensionable retirees: last basic pay plus 5% of basic per year of additional post-retirement experience, with Rs. 8000/- (Fixed) transport allowance. Initial engagement for one year, extendable based on TRAI's requirements and mutual consent up to the age of 65 years Term may be extended up to 70 years in deserving cases with approval of Chairperson TRAI Consultant is not an employee of TRAI and must give an undertaking as per Annexure-I Contract may be terminated by either side with one month's written notice Paid leave @ 1.5 day per completed month besides Gazetted holidays; no carry forward

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of Birth Certificate (Secondary school certificate or 10th class Mark Sheet showing date of birth, Birth Certificate issued by Municipal Authority) Educational qualification(s) from 10th class onwards; degree certificates (Provisional or Final) with mark sheets of all semesters Post qualification experience/employment Copy of PPO (in case of retired from pensionable organization) Any other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TRAI Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online only through https://vacancies.trai.gov.in. Applications by post, email or any other means will not be considered. Upload clear and legible self-attested copies of the listed documents with the online application. Last date for receipt of online applications is 07 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 December 2026. Applications opened on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Consultant (Retired Govt. Servant).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TRAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 64 years (as on the date of Vacancy Circular).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration fixed as per Table-I / Table-II in para 3 (based on last pay and pension); transport allowance Rs. 8000 (Fixed) per month for retirees of non-pensionable organisations.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Science (Maths and Physics) from a recognized university/institution; retired officers of Central/State Govt/Departments/PSU/Autonomous Bodies at pay level 10 & above at retirement with minimum 15 years of total experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible Indian Citizens. Must have retired at pay level 10 & above (7th CPC/equivalent IDA level). Should be in good health and capable of performing official duties at the time of engagement. Vigilance Clearance shall be obtained for retired officials as per extant CVC/Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received by post, email or other means. Incomplete applications or applications without the documents in Para 6(a) to 6(d).

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial engagement for one year, extendable based on TRAI's requirements and mutual consent up to the age of 65 years. Term may be extended up to 70 years in deserving cases with approval of Chairperson TRAI. Consultant is not an employee of TRAI and must give an undertaking as per Annexure-I.

faq.answer: TRAI Camp Office, Guwahati (under Regional Office Kolkata).
